These runes will then be used to cast bolt and blast spells when the box is wielded in the shield slot. Also adds the chance of critical hits with these spells to add 25% damage.

name: Celestial surgebox (reward)
description: The celestial surgebox can be charged with certain runes used in wave or surge spells. Runes within the surgebox can be used alongside other runes or rune-supplying items such as elemental staves to cast wave or surge spells, depending on which setting the box is set to. Every fifth spell cast from the celestial surgebox will score a "critical hit" and deal 25% extra damage in a separate hitsplat.

name: Jungle Gorilla
description: Deep from within Karamja comes this formidable beast. Adventure with the powerful Jungle Gorilla, and help him grow from adorable baby to fearsome adult.
column1:
Jungle Gorilla
* A legendary pet that looks awesome and grows up with you!
* 3 appearances - Unlock new appearances as your pet grows, and choose which one to call.
* Animations - Interact with your Gorilla as it grows, from playful youth to fearless beast!
* ALL NEW Home Teleports - Each stage has a unique teleport animation, watch as your pet learns to embrace its roots by climbing and swinging to your chosen destination!
column2: Some areas of the game, such as minigames or boss battles, do not allow pets. Teleports require you to have the pet out to work. Teleports do not work in instances.

column2: Some areas of the game, such as minigames or boss battles, do not allow pets. Teleports require you to have the pet out to work. Teleports do not work in instances.

name: Party pack
description: Chock-full of fun, consumable items to make any celebration extra special.
column1:
Warning! The Party Pack expires one hour after being placed (see below for more detail). Items taken from the Party Pack last one hour from the time they are taken, but disappear if you log out, or are consumed. Contains the following items: 
* Cake Hat - 1 per Party Pack. Only claimable by Party Pack owner. Can be given to other players. Allows the 'Congratulate' emote to be played on wearer. Looks awesome.
* Music Box - Only claimable by Party Pack owner. Click to hear the music and dance along. Everyone who clicks and dances will automatically keep in step! Expires after one hour.
* Party Cake - Only claimable by Party Pack owner. Place in the world and anyone can click to take a delicious slice.
* Glass of Bubbly - Interacting with another player who is also holding a glass of Bubbly allows the 'Cheers!' emote. Also initiates the 'Congratulate' emote if used on a player who is wearing the Cake Hat (see above).
* Sparklers - Watch the fizzing sparks fly through the air! Consumed on use.
* Party Poppers - Fires colourful paper streamers into the air. Consumed on use.
* Party Horns - No party is complete without them!
column2: Party Packs last one hour after being placed in the world. They can disappear sooner if the server is restarted, or if it is placed in an instanced area that is then destroyed. Unless otherwise noted, most items can be withdrawn from the pack multiple times.

name: Wicked pouch (uncharged)
description: This item accepts runes of any kind then fuels your spells with their power. Ideal when a variety of spells and runes might be called for. Also allows immediate spellbook and prayer switching.
column2:
* Cannot be purchased in Ironman mode.
* Doesn't work in the Wilderness or unsafe minigames.
* Works only with normal overworld runes, not on special runes such as from Dungeoneering, Runespan or minigames.
* Spells that use the Make-X interface don't accept Wicked Pouch energy.
* Spellbook and prayer switching requires additional spellbooks and/or curses unlocked, and is available in any bank area.

name: Keepsake key
description: Consume to use any piece of equipment as a cosmetic override.
column1:
Use one Keepsake Key to convert a single piece of equipment. 
Converted items can be reclaimed by visiting the Customisation Menu. 
The Keepsake Key is consumed once the item is reclaimed. 
Once an item is reclaimed, it will no longer be used as a cosmetic override. 
The item to be converted must be in any of the following slots: 
* Hat
* Cape
* Amulet
* Torso
* Legs
* Gloves
* Boots
* Main hand
* Off-hand
For a full list of the items which can be converted please refer to the Runescape Wiki 
When an item is converted, it is stored in the Keepsake Box and cannot be equipped, traded, or lent while stored.
column2: Does not work on lent items. You must meet the necessary requirements to equip the item before it is possible to convert it. Converting must be done in the bank area or in dungeoneering. Reclaiming can only be done in the bank area. All limitations applicable to cosmetic items are also applicable to the item converted.

name: Boon of the Companion
description: Unlocks a loyal companion - the legendary pet, Luma.

name: Boon of Endurance
description: Provides infinite run energy. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Regeneration
description: In addition to any other regeneration effects, your life points, prayer points and summoning points regenerate by 5% every 6 seconds while you're outside of combat. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of the Artisan I
description: 10% chance to save resources when training Construction, Crafting, Firemaking and Fletching. 10% chance to produce double items when training Cooking, Herblore and Runecrafting. +10% chance for double progress when training Smithing. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Ammunition I
description: 25% chance to save your runes, arrows, bolts, darts, throwing knives, throwing axes and javelins in combat. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Vigour I
description: Your base life points, prayer points and summoning points are boosted by 10%. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of the Artisan II
description: Doubles the maximum actions of any Cooking, Construction, Crafting, Divination, Firemaking, Fletching, Herblore, Invention, Magic and Smithing production methods. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Ammunition II
description: 50% chance to save your runes, arrows, bolts, darts, throwing knives, throwing axes and javelins in combat. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Vigour II
description: Your base life points, prayer points and summoning points are boosted by 25%. This boon is deactivated when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Defence
description: Provides a hybrid armour that upgrades as you level up your Defence skill.

name: Boon of Offence
description: Provides a hybrid weapon that upgrades as you level up your combat skills. You can switch it between Melee, Ranged and Magic.

name: Boon of Luck I
description: Provides a ring that gives combat style bonuses and grants tier 1 luck, which improves your chances to receive rare rewards from various activities. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Plenty I
description: Provides a collection of items that can help you level your skills. This includes: - 10 medium prismatic stars, which give you Bonus XP in a skill of your choice. -5 pulse cores, which grant a +50% XP boost while worn until consumed. - 5 cinder cores, which grant a +150% Bonus XP burn boost while worn until consumed. - 50 of each protean item, which can be consumed to grant XP in a specific skill.

name: Boon of Healing
description: Provides a cornucopia of food that never depletes. It can heal some life points every 5 minutes. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Plenty II
description: Provides a collection of items that can help you level your skills. This includes: - 10 tiny portable skilling packs, which hold portable skilling stations that let you train certain skills more efficiently until consumed. - 10 combat dummies, which let you train your combat skills until consumed. - 5 medium skill training dummy crates, which hold dummies that let you train certain skills until consumed.

name: Boon of Plenty III
description: Provides a collection of items that can help you level your skills. This includes: - The spring cleaner, which can convert selected enemy drops into various helpful resources while charged with springs or tight springs. - 100 tight springs, which can charge or upgrade the spring cleaner. - The silverhawk boots, which periodically grant Agility XP while running or skilling, if charged with silverhawk feathers or down. - 100 silverhawk down, which can charge the silverhawk boots. - 100 magic notepaper, which can note items to make them stackable. If you already own the spring cleaner or silverhawk boots, you will not receive them from this collection.

name: Boon of Luck II
description: Provides a ring that gives combat style bonuses and grants tier 2 luck, which improves your chances to receive rare rewards from various activities. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Banking
description: Provides a deposit box that can be activated once a day to allow you to deposit items from your backpack to your bank for one hour. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Luck III
description: Provides a ring that gives combat style bonuses and grants tier 3 luck, which improves your chances to receive rare rewards from various activities. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of Luck IV
description: Provides a ring that gives combat style bonuses and grants tier 4 luck, which improves your chances to receive rare rewards from various activities. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Boon of the Porter
description: Provides the challenger porter, which has a 50% chance to transport certain items directly to your bank when you receive them. This item is removed when you transition from Fresh Start Worlds.

name: Dungeoneering experience
description: This option allows you to trade dungeoneering tokens for Dungeoneering skill XP at a rate of 1:1.

name: Ring of kinship#Reset
description: This will allow you to reset your ring of kinship, refunding you the tokens spent on customisations. You can only have a maximum of 1 reset at a time.

name: Hoardstalker ring#Recharge
description: This will recharge a depleted hoardstalker ring in your inventory.

name: Wild card
description: Unlock the ability to gain a free card upon entering a sinkhole.

name: Bonecrusher
description: This item requires a Prayer level of 21 to purchase. If you have a bonecrusher in your inventory, pocket or tool belt, dropped bones from monster kills will automatically be converted into Prayer XP. You can configure which bones are converted.

name: Herbicide
description: You may choose for this item, if held in the inventory, pocket or tool belt, to corrode and destroy selected herbs instead of being dropped. This provides you with 2x the usual cleaning XP in Herblore. (Does not apply to certed herb drops.)

name: Charming imp
description: As well as being good company, a charming imp held in the inventory, pocket or tool belt will automatically pick up dropped charms for you. Selected charms can be donated to the imp's own collection instead in exchange for a small amount of Summoning XP.

name: Scroll of life
description: This item requires a Farming level of 25 to unlock. When unlocked, farmers who harvest patches have a permanent 10% chance of receiving their seeds back. There is also a 5% chance of getting a tree seed back from a dead tree/stump. For herb seeds, the seed type returned may be random.

name: Gem bag
description: This item requires a Crafting level of 25. The gem bag can hold uncut gems of the following types: sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond. The bag can hold a maximum of 100 gems.

name: Arcane pulse necklace
description: This item can be worn by mages with a Magic level of 30 or higher and provides +13 magic bonus.

name: Farsight quick shot necklace
description: This item can be worn by rangers with a Ranged level of 30 or higher and provides +13 ranged bonus.

name: Brawler's jab necklace
description: This item can be worn by warriors with an Attack level of 30 or higher and provides +13 strength bonus.

name: Twisted bird skull necklace
description: This item requires a Prayer level of 30 to wear. It restores 50 prayer points for burying some bones and absorbing most demonic ashes and ghosts with the attuned ectoplasmator.

name: Smithing autoheater
description: This item automatically consumes 5 coal from your metal bank to re-heat your smithing items when they cool down.

name: Advanced smithing autoheater
description: This upgrade allows your autoheater to go into overheat mode consuming 50 coal to re-heat your smithing items when they cool down.

name: Gem bag (upgraded)
description: This will upgrade your gem bag from within your inventory to allow storage of 60 gems each, including dragonstones.

name: Longbow sight
description: This item can be attached to a maple, magic or elder longbow to increase its damage, accuracy and defence. Requires 45 Ranged for maple, 55 for magic, 65 for elder.

name: Law staff
description: This item requires a Magic level of 45 to wield. You can store up to 1000 law runes in the staff. When casting spells that use law runes, there is a 1/10 chance that a law rune will not be used.

name: Gravite rapier
description: This item requires an Attack level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

name: Off-hand gravite rapier
description: This item requires an Attack level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

description: This item requires an Attack level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

description: This item requires a Magic level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

name: Gravite chargebow
description: This item requires a Ranged level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

name: Gravite knife
description: This item requires a Ranged level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

name: Gravite orb
description: This item requires a Magic level of 55 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.

name: Tome of frost
description: This item requires a Magic level of 48 to wield. This item acts as an infinite number of water runes, reduces dehydration damage in the desert, and can be equipped in the offhand slot.

name: Amulet of zealots
description: The item, when wielded, improves the effect of any prayer that boosts only one skill. It comes with a -5 penalty to your prayer points.

name: Scroll of cleansing
description: Reading this scroll permanently unlocks the wasteless herblore ability: when concocting a potion, there is a chance you will complete the potion slightly quicker, and that you will save the secondary item completely.

name: Spirit cape
description: This cape gives a strength, ranged, magic, and necromancy bonus of 17. Also when purchased permanently reduces the cost of any scroll abilities that your combat familiars have by 20%

name: Nature staff
description: This item requires a Magic level of 53 to wield. You can store up to 1000 nature runes in the staff. When casting spells that use nature runes, there is a 1/10 chance that a nature rune will not be used.

name: Scroll of efficiency
description: Reading this scroll permanently unlocks the efficiency smithing perk: You have a 2% chance to refund bars used when completing a smithing item.

name: Arcane blast necklace
description: This item can be worn by mages with a Magic level of 50 or higher and provides +24 magic bonus.

name: Farsight snap shot necklace
description: This item can be worn by rangers with a Ranged level of 50 or higher and provides +24 ranged bonus.

name: Brawler's hook necklace
description: This item can be worn by warriors with an Attack level of 50 or higher and provides +24 strength bonus.

name: Split dragontooth necklace
description: This item requires a Prayer level of 60 to wear. It restores between 50 and 100 prayer points for burying certain bones and absorbing most demonic ashes and ghosts with the attuned ectoplasmator.

name: Anti-poison totem
description: This item requires 70 Herblore to wield. Grants immunity to poison when equipped. Does not remove poison if equipped after being poisoned.

name: Scroll of proficiency
description: Reading this scroll permanently unlocks the Proficient Construction trait: when constructing a piece of furniture that requires three planks or more, there is a chance that you will retain one plank. The chance is 50% for normal planks, 25% for oak, 20% for teak, 10% for mahogany and 5% for protean.

name: Scroll of dexterity
description: Reading this scroll permanently unlocks the Efficient Crafting trait: when creating an item using Crafting that requires three or more of the same ingredient, there is a chance that you will retain one of that ingredient,. The chance is related to the Crafting level required to create that item.

name: Gold accumulator
description: This magical device will draw dropped coins from monsters you kill straight to your money pouch. This item will collect 1 million coins before degrading to dust.
misc: Initially costs 20,000 tokens, increasing by 20,000 tokens for each purchase, up to a maximum of 60,000 tokens per purchase.

name: Gold accumulator#Overcharge

name: Advanced gold accumulator
description: This magical device will draw dropped coins from monsters you kill straight to your money pouch. This item does not degrade, but will consume 10% of the gold picked up.

name: Ring of vigour
